items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Mitchell formed our group and called us the Colored Dixieland Band.

ctx.x: They claim, but I have no proof of it, you know. Abbie Mitchell, she became one of the very famous prima donnas. She was a prima donna with most of his shows and things.
But they claim, I don't know, if it's just one of those things that you hear, you hear a lot of things, but I have no proof of it.
